config.stacksizeadjuster.title: Stack Size Adjuster
config.stacksizeadjuster.option.limit_64:
Limit for items that normally stack to 64. Default: 128. (Recommended: 39,768,215 or lower to prevent container overflows.)

§6Notice:§r Global configuration settings only define default values for newly generated worlds. For existing worlds, change settings in-game via /gamerule or the GameRules edit GUI screen.
config.stacksizeadjuster.option.limit_16:
Limit for items that normally stack to 16. Default: 32. (Recommended: 39,768,215 or lower to prevent container overflows.)

§6Notice:§r Global configuration settings only define default values for newly generated worlds. For existing worlds, change settings in-game via /gamerule or the GameRules edit GUI screen.
Limit for items that normally do not stack. Default: 1. (Recommended: 39,768,215 or lower to prevent container overflows.)

§6Notice:§r Global configuration settings only define default values for newly generated worlds. For existing worlds, change settings in-game via /gamerule or the GameRules edit GUI screen.
config.stacksizeadjuster.option.warning: ⚠️ WARNING: Do you really want to set the value to %d? Large stack counts (millions/billions) can cause game lag/stutter when moving or sorting items! Additionally, setting values above 39,768,215 is highly likely to cause Large Chest total counts to overflow the 2.14 billion integer limit and delete your items! 39,768,215 or lower is strongly recommended. Change it at your own risk!
config.stacksizeadjuster.option.max_drop:
Maximum item entities spawned per inventory slot when a container (chest, barrel, etc.) breaks.

§eVanilla Default:§r No cap — vanilla splits every stack into tiny piles of 10–30 items, spawning potentially thousands of entities for large stacks and causing massive lag.

§aRecommended (8):§r Limits each slot to at most 8 item entities. Provides good visual scatter while preventing entity-spawn lag. Item Clumps merges them moments later.

§bLow Values (1):§r Maximum performance — each slot drops as a single entity. Item Clumps merges everything instantly.

§6Notice:§r Global configuration settings only define default values for newly generated worlds. For existing worlds, change settings in-game via /gamerule or the GameRules edit GUI screen.
gamerule.stack-size-adjuster.items_64_li: Maximum stack size for items that naturally stack to 64. WARNING: Keep under 39,768,215 to prevent Large Chest integer overflows and item movement lag. Change it at your own risk!
gamerule.stack-size-adjuster.items_16_li: Maximum stack size for items that naturally stack to 16. WARNING: Keep under 39,768,215 to prevent Large Chest integer overflows and item movement lag. Change it at your own risk!
gamerule.stack-size-adjuster.items_1_lim: Maximum stack size for items that naturally stack to 1. WARNING: Keep under 39,768,215 to prevent Large Chest integer overflows and item movement lag. Change it at your own risk!
gamerule.stack-size-adjuster.max_drop_en: Maximum item entities spawned per inventory slot when a container breaks. Vanilla has no cap and spawns thousands of entities for large stacks. Default: 8 (recommended). Set to 1 for maximum performance.
